title: Effect branch is a free player choice instead of being determined by the revealed rune's domain
expected: Card def /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/twisted-fate-gambler.ts:32-76 models the domain-gated switch as an unconditioned `type: "choice"` with options fury/mind/order (comment at lines 15-16 admits it is "approximating the actual domain-gated switch"). No option carries a condition on the revealed rune's domain, and the preceding `look` (line 22-26) does not bind the revealed rune for later gating. Engine handler /root/src/tcg/tcg-engines/packages/riftbound-engine/src/abilities/effects/choice.ts:15-31 turns any >=2-option choice into a player-facing `choose-mode` pendingChoice listing all option indices, so the player freely picks any branch (including with a Chaos or Fury rune on top), matching the observed behavior.
observed: Engine presented pendingChoice type 'choose-mode' with options fury/mind/order every time; player could pick Draw 1 or Stun with a Chaos or Fury rune on top and the chosen branch executed (hand 5->6 for mind; enemy stunned for order)
